avis.texte: I plan to purchase these again. Now, I must say, the price point was a little steep for me - but worth it. Maybe add two more masks to the box and I could justify it. In terms of the mask itself, it’s amazing. I put them in the refrigerator for the nice cooling affect on my face. It is easy to apply and feel so so so good when you put it on. I kept it on for about three hours before the mask began to become translucent. Once I took it off, I had a delicious healthy glow that was super prominent for two days even through my normal skincare routine. My skin was so healthy and really drank up the nutrients from the mask. It smells nice and had left my skin soft and hydrated. Excellent excellent excellent product. I definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Gentle masks that hydrate and firm
avis.texte: These masks feel wonderful. They leave my skin so soft and moisturized. They are great on my sensitive skin and do not irritate me at all. They are a great value and I love that they leave my skin glowing. They fit well (much better than some other masks I have tried) and are easy to put on after the first try. They do not mention which side goes towards your face, but I have used them many times and it does not seem to matter. I have tried several Korean skin care masks and these are my favorite.

I like it. Made my skin glow. It indeed said 75 masks though which was annoying cause I got only 4, and they didn't have an option to pick 75 masks so I don't know where the rest of those rice masks are at

I really like these ! for the first 5mins they don't stay on too well but afterwards I'm able to walk around do house work or go to bed and it won't slide off they fit my face nicely and my skin wakes up plump and shiny , it does not have a strong smell to it either, did not irritate my sensitive combo skin
These masks work well. I choose to keep mine in the refrigerator. It’s very soothing to put them on when they are so cool. I leave mine on for about three hours. I highly recommend this item.
Leaves my skin soft and glowing . I’m an esthetician and find these to be high quality!

I bought this mask after seeing an Instagrammer promoting it on her account, from which she receives benefits from America. Fortunately, I was able to find it in the UAE at a quite good price. Summary: I’m not sure if the mask is easy to apply or not, because it has a sort of film and you can’t tell which side is the correct one. After wearing it for two hours, I noticed that the mask dries out and turns into something like a nest or a dried fruit, but it never reaches that point where it becomes transparent. I felt a bit disappointed; I thought it would be more like the description — you put it on and after three hours it turns transparent. No, that’s not the case. It dries out and ends up looking like a fig
素材がヌルヌルしていて、顔につけると抑えていないと少しずつ下がってきます。15分くらいすると、少し乾いてくますが、ストレスを感じました。
It does not normally stick as too large for any face. Effect is yet unclear, but it is already clear that it is not convenient one

avis.titre: Yes to sleeping with the face mask it’s top tier
avis.texte: This product is incredible! I woke up with baby-smooth skin. I will certainly be buying again. I highly recommend it! Your skin feels so relaxed that you fall asleep quickly. This product is truly magical.

This mask is amazing. Used over night and my skin was glowing the next morning. My husband said to me " your face is literally glowing and sparkles". Yes ladies sparkles! my face felt smooth and hydrated in just one night. I put on before bed ( took about 2 minutes and super easy) and let set for about 20 minutes before going to sleep. Woke up next morning , took off and bam perfection! Definitely worth the price for my weekly face mask! Also, side note- super sensitive skin and always have to use hyperalogenic products... and this did not make me itch or have a single out break!

avis.titre: Leaves skin hydrated, plump, and glowing with no sticky feel.
avis.texte: The sheet is soft, fits well, and is soaked in serum. After using it, my skin feels plump, hydrated, and noticeably smoother with a healthy glow. It doesn’t leave a sticky residue and has a light, pleasant scent. Perfect for a quick self-care moment or before makeup for extra radianCe

This mask will do what it is supposed to do if you are patient. Full absorption will take about 30 minutes hence why it is better to use it as a sleep mask . Your skin will immediately feel supple and you get an instant glow. Great value for money!

avis.titre: Works as intended! Although a little drying for my skin.
avis.texte: It works wonderful at brightening your skin, however, for me, it dried out my combination skin so I only gave it 4 stars. If you’re on the oilyer side, then this one is for you! The heart leaf one (green one) is the best for hydration and brightening! Personally, that one is my all time favorite.
I love the glow of my face after I use it. It hydrates my face well. I love Anua products.

Great overnight mask. It's very comfortable when you're sleeping and doesn't bother you. It makes your skin so glowy and pretty. The only thing is I wish there would have been more masks but otherwise five stars⭐
It says 70 collagen but I received just 4 pieces . This is so unfair .
Me encanta demasiado, no la he probado pero tiene muchos ingredientes que son buenos. La probaré.

avis.titre: It’s Okay - Didn't contain a lot essence
avis.texte: This different than any other mask I tired. It comes in 2 separate pieces. The pieces are separated by plastic. The mask is silicone like and it reminds on jello. It kept jiggling and sliding off my hand. The directions said to apply to the face and remove it when the color of the mask turns transparent. I had the mask on for over 25 mins and the color didn’t change so I ended up removing the mask. The color was exactly the same as when I initially placed on my face. I removed it because I can tell that the mask was drying out. Once I removed it, my didn’t look any different but it felt cold and dry so I assume I kept the mask on for longer than I should. I noticed that it didn't have a lot essence right out of the packaging. Based on my experience, I’m not really a fan of the mask. Maybe I didn’t apply properly, but I followed the directions. I think this will be better in the summer to get that cool/cold sensation.

This mask is just FULL of good ingredients, things I love finding in my skincare, like niacinamide, rice bran extract, allantoin, panthenol, and so much more. There's not a single known irritant or added fragrance, which I SO appreciate, and I'm sure people with sensitive skin will be happy to see it too. This is one of those two-piece hydrogel like masks that you leave for as long as it becomes transparent/overnight if you can. I put it on overnight so I can't attest to how long it takes exactly to become transparent. This left my skin feeling nice, soft, and looking great! The material of the mask makes it easy to sit on your face for hours and the two-piece aspect also helps. I love this brand and this mask was no exception to their great products!
